question_text: A battery-powered logger has a fixed RAM budget and strict timing deadlines. Outline two disadvantages of growing a dynamic list compared with pre allocating a suitable fixed-size buffer.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Growth/resizing may require allocating a new memory block and copying elements.; This can introduce variable delays, complicating the deadline guarantee.; Spare capacity/meta data and temporary old/new blocks can increase memory use.; A tight RAM budget can therefore be exceeded during growth.
